plugins.name: tribe
plugins.description: Six agents under a strict chain of command (Owner ⇄ Shaman ⇄ Warchief ⇄ Hunter, plus three review specialists): the Shaman is the owner's delegate for What & Why and runs the campaign; the Warchief turns one idea card at a time into a merged, evidenced PR via TDD Hunters; the Hunter implements one task under strict TDD; the Tracker reviews every diff against the repo's written rules; the Skinner adversarially audits claimed-done work against its requirement contract by running the proof; the Scout surveys standing code for defect-inviting structure. Questions flow up as statuses, decisions flow down as cards and briefs.

plugins.name: verify-shipped
plugins.description: Mechanically verify the tribe's Definition of Done: PR merged, master in sync with origin, worktree removed.
